subject: Post-discovery recap + scheduling 30m product intro

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery recap + scheduling 30m product intro

Hi Emily —

Great to meet with you and Marco earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (30s):
- Primary use case: improving search & triage for Care Ops (near-term) with embeddings + reranking.
- Key constraint: PHI handling and audit logs — you flagged retention and KMS requirements.
- Success metric you mentioned: 40% reduction in manual triage time within pilot.

Open items for the next meeting (30-min demo):
1) Walk through a short product demo (30m) focused on embedding ingestion and rerank pipeline.
2) Review security controls (SOC2 evidence, KMS options) at a high level — Neha can cover this.
3) Identify pilot scope and technical owner(s) for a follow-up technical deep dive.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue Feb 17 — 10:00–10:30am PT
- Option B: Wed Feb 18 — 1:00–1:30pm PT
- Option C: Thu Feb 19 — 2:00–2:30pm PT

Can you pick one or two that work, or send your preferred times? I attached my discovery notes from today as a short PDF.

Attendees we plan to bring: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) for the demo, Neha Kapoor (Security & Compliance) for the controls overview. If Marco or anyone else should be present for the pilot scoping, please loop them in.

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
https://redwoodinference.com

Attachment: 20260211-discovery-notes.pdf (1 page - bullet highlights)

- Wed Feb 18 — 10:00am PT OR

- 5–20m: Live product walkthrough (Ben will demo embeddings ingestion + rerank flow)
- 20–27m: Security controls overview (Neha — SOC2, KMS, retention options)
- 27–30m: Next steps / pilot owners and actions

Meeting link (placeholder): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite

Emily/Marco — will you confirm who on your team will attend? Names + roles help shape the demo (ops vs. data engineering).

Thanks — sending the invite now.

—Sean
